description: Read everything the catalog knows about one object: overall size, holes and features, notes, size tables, mating features, related objects, FAQ, and every public CAD source with its license. Use it to answer how big something is, where its holes are, what it is made for, or where its CAD comes from. It returns no download links (get_free_files) and no file contents (get_file_content); use get_fits when only the mating features are needed, since this sheet is long. Sizes are exact nominal values with no tolerance added. The response says whether free files exist and, for the few sold Xem design packs, lists paid_offers with prices; nothing is ever charged by this tool. An unknown object is an error with a hint to search first. Read-only, no auth. On this channel paid_offers carry the agent price and the x402 URL (answers 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED; pay in USDC on Base and retry) as well as the card price and page for people.

object.description: Object slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact object name or alias also resolves; anything else is an error with a hint to search first.

name: get_geometry

dimensions.description: How to read the sizes: exact nominal, no printing tolerance.

faq.description: Frequently asked questions about this object.

mating.description: Mating features with exact sizes and fit classes.

exact.description: Its exact size, in mm, with no clearance.

files.description: Which of the object's files carry this feature ('all' or a file name).

fit.description: Fit class: press | slide | run | socket | clamp | designed.

mates.description: What it meets: another object, a standard part, or a fastener size.

paid_offers.description: Files sold for this object; nothing is charged by this tool.

card_price_usd.description: Price for a person paying by card.

price_usd.description: Price for this channel in USD.

x402_url.description: Endpoint an agent pays with x402.

related.description: Slugs of related objects; call get_geometry on them to traverse.

sheet.description: The dimension sheet: overall_mm, basis (where the numbers come from), notes, table (columns and rows), question answered.

sheet_text.description: The same sheet as plain text, ready to quote.

items.description: A public CAD or dimension source: publisher, title, url, formats, license, whether Xem hosts it.
